title: Agent Talk talk token claims
description: The payload of the talk token: a compact JWS in the header, the block or the link of an email that opens or voices a step. It names a talk and a step and grants nothing.
$comment: Protected header: { "alg": "EdDSA", "kid": <key id in the issuer's keys>, "typ": "agent-talk-talk" } (see $defs/protectedHeader). Checks only code can do: the signature against a key of iss; sub equal to the message's From (not for a token read from a link); iat at most 5 minutes ahead of the receiver's clock; exp, the ask's expires, at most 30 days after iat; now before exp. The reference implementation's own claim check only checks that iss, talk, step and sub are strings and v a number (then v must be 1).
